LibreDWG compilé en WebAssembly pour la visionneuse str-bim-tools.com/dxf (str-dwg.js + str-dwg.wasm).

Licence : GNU GPL version 3 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html), comme LibreDWG.

Sources correspondantes :
- LibreDWG : https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web, commit b5177613f2c735858a6d1cb1d1c7e238c397b88f
  (fork de GNU LibreDWG, https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/), non modifié.
- Fonctions ajoutées : str_dwg.c (dans ce dossier) : str_dwg_vers_dxf (DWG -> DXF) et str_dxf_vers_dwg
  (DXF -> DWG AutoCAD 2000).

Compilation (Emscripten 4.0.15) :
  ./autogen.sh
  mkdir build-wasm && cd build-wasm
  emconfigure ../configure CFLAGS="-O2 -DNDEBUG" CC=emcc --enable-release --disable-docs --disable-python \
    --disable-bindings --disable-shared --disable-json
  emmake make -C src
  emcc str_dwg.c src/.libs/libredwg.a -O2 -Isrc -I../src -I../include -o str-dwg.js -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 \
    -sMAXIMUM_MEMORY=4GB -sMODULARIZE=1 -sEXPORT_ES6=1 -sEXPORT_NAME=createModule -sENVIRONMENT=web,worker \
    -sEXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS=FS,ccall -sEXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=_str_dwg_vers_dxf,_str_dxf_vers_dwg,_malloc,_free
